pm_collateral_supplied.meaning: the Vault has supplied collateral under PM (via executeHedge()/supplyToBlp()) before the checked settlement

pm_borrow_liability_present.meaning: PM auto-borrow/borrow-lend state has created a negative quote liability for the account before the checked settlement

precompile_payload_has_borrow_and_supply.meaning: the 0x811 payload for the token contains borrow.basis, borrow.value, supply.basis and supply.value

insurance_share_routed.meaning: distributeYield() routes the insurance share into InsuranceFund

assumptions: The insurance share routing is the distribution step of distributeYield() following a settle() that accepted yield despite the PM borrow liability.
The report describes a potential scenario; the routing is treated as the report-supported conditional outcome, not an inevitable one.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric borrow.value/supply.value/surplus/proposedYield, so the phantom-surplus magnitude relation (backing exceeding liabilities) cannot be encoded numerically; only the qualitative routing outcome is bound.
Report does not specify whether settle() and distributeYield() are separate transactions or their ordering, so the checkpoint of the routing relative to settlement is only loosely fixed.

limitations: Only the insurance-share routing impact is formalized; other listed impacts (escrow USDC movement, USDM minting, foundation share) are handled in separate passes.
The condition uses qualitative booleans for PM collateral/liability presence because the report gives no numeric operands for the net-state comparison.
The potential modality of the underlying scenario is preserved by treating routing as a conditional outcome rather than an inevitable effect.
